name: Ōtsuki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōtsuki city emblem in light blue: a winged device above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ōtsuki, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1954.

features.role: Ōtsuki city emblem — a winged device above a ring
